article_context: Cover image for an article about earning attention and trust before purchase: a shopper calmly considers options on a tablet rather than responding to a hard sell.
image_reading: A woman sits on a sofa holding a tablet with a product-grid interface; a shopping basket is beside her.
Her raised hand is already poised over a visible product tile, making a restrained browsing gesture credible.
The tablet interface is a meaningful focal element and must remain visually unchanged.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The woman slowly moves her fingertip toward one existing product tile and comes to a calm hover above it; the tablet interface remains unchanged, ending with her hand poised in a considered choice.
models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, keep the camera fixed on the woman and tablet. Her hand makes one slow, deliberate approach toward the already visible tile, with a natural easing at the end. Finish with her fingertip steadily hovering above the tile; the product grid does not change.

models.positive_prompt: With a fixed camera, the woman makes one unhurried browsing gesture, bringing her fingertip to hover over an existing product option. End with her hand settled above the tile in a thoughtful decision; the screen stays unchanged.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, use a fixed view. Let the poised hand travel a modest distance toward a visible option at an even pace, then settle near the end into a stable hover. The tablet remains legible and unchanged, expressing careful consideration rather than an impulsive purchase.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the woman and tablet. She gently brings one finger toward an existing product tile, ending in a steady hover that conveys a considered choice; the tablet display remains unchanged.
models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, maintain a fixed camera and focus on the tablet. The woman completes one compact, smooth approach gesture with her fingertip toward a visible tile, slowing into the endpoint near the last frame. End with the hand poised above the same tile and all UI content unchanged.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A potential customer is given space to consider a relevant option, illustrating attention and trust before purchase.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman deliberately moves her fingertip toward one visible product tile and settles into a hover.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Her calm, thoughtful consideration of the available options remains unchanged through the final frame.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Her fingertip is steadily poised above the same visible product tile while the tablet interface remains unchanged.
